ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; approximately 98% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels to 2% high-intensity (white) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous low-intensity region covering >95% of fluke area; localized high-intensity punctate spots (mottling) distributed sparsely on the interior of the left lobe and a singular distinct linear high-intensity mark on the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 50 degrees; depth is moderate, extending roughly 15% into the vertical height of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge; distinct peaks and valleys observed with pixel amplitudes ranging from 5-15 pixels in depth relative to the edge mean.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong concave curvature originating from the median notch and transitioning into a steep upward arc towards the distal apices.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly localized clusters of high-contrast, circular high-intensity pixel groups (barnacle colonization) located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal linear scratch (rake mark) located on the right lobe, approximately mid-way between the notch and the tip; additional thin, short-duration linear marks visible on the left lobe interior.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the posterior tips of both lobes; distinct diagonal white rake mark on the right lobe ventral surface.
